• Laboratory Data
• Autoantibodies
• Inflammatory Markers
• Imaging
• Pathology
• Genetics
• Medication
• Infusion Therapy
• Functional Status
• Patient-reported Outcomes

Integrations:

• Immunology

• Dermatology
• Ophthalmology
• Cardiology
• Pulmonology
• Neurology
• Genetics
• Rehabilitation

AI Functions:

• Multisystem Correlation
• Clinical Summarization
• Disease Activity Trend Support
• Missing-data Detection

MVP Relevance:
HIGH

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Rheumatology retains longitudinal phenotype, disease activity, multisystem assessment and source-specific evidence. Laboratory biomarkers alone cannot become a diagnosis or treatment authorization. Shared medication and consent owners control immunosuppression context; preserve joint, ocular, renal, growth, function and vaccination profiles separately.
